svg.title: Private connectivity, end to end
svg.desc: Private ingress and outbound VNet integration are different paths. DNS resolves service names to private endpoint addresses through the existing central infrastructure.

text.tspan: Resolve the hostname first. Send the HTTPS request second.
The reply contains the private IP of the requested service.
Logical subnet roles, not a prescribed VNet topology. PE roles may share a subnet.
PRIVATE INGRESS IS NOT PRIVATE EGRESS
Client authentication and gateway managed identity remain separate.
DNS returns an address; it does not carry the model request. Responses use the same private request path.
Reference design · Gateway/models: staged private-only target · Target environment requires validation
